trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Greet the user and state the reason for the call without disclosing sensitive info.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी admissions team मधून बोलतोय. एका pending application बद्दल call केला आहे. Am I speaking with the applicant?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for a quick explanation.
steps.text: हो, बोलतोय. काय झालं? I am in a meeting, थोडक्यात सांगा.

steps.purpose: Ask for the registered name to verify identity.
steps.text: नक्कीच. माहिती देण्यापूर्वी मला तुमची identity verify करावी लागेल. तुमचं registered name सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Provide the registered name.
Attempt to verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return a successful verification.
Acknowledge verification and state the application ID being called about.
steps.text: Thank you, details verify झाले आहेत. मी तुमच्या APP-1009 application बद्दल call केला आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask why the application is stalled and what the current status is.
steps.text: Oh, माझं application stalled का आहे? Status नक्की काय आहे सद्या?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and prepare to check the status.
steps.text: मला एक मिनिट द्या, मी system मध्ये check करतो.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the applicant's current application stage.
Return the applicant's record.
Inform the user of the current application stage.
steps.text: तुमचं application सध्या 'documents_pending' stage मध्ये आहे, त्यामुळे ते stalled आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the status, state intention to upload documents, state current marks, and ask for an eligibility estimate for Engineering.
steps.text: अच्छा, मी documents नंतर upload करतो. पण माझे marks पुरेसे आहेत का? माझं 12th PCM मध्ये 79 percent आहे. मला Engineering करायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: Check the course eligibility for Engineering.
Return a failure as Engineering is an invalid course.

result.reason: Invalid course 'Engineering'. Please specify a valid course like 'B.Tech'.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the failure and attempt recovery by checking B.Tech.
steps.text: System मध्ये 'Engineering' course invalid दाखवत आहे. मी 'B.Tech' साठी eligibility check करतो.

steps.purpose: Check the course eligibility for B.Tech.
Return the eligibility status, required percentage, seats, and fee.
Relay the eligibility details, required percentage, seats remaining, and annual fee.
steps.text: तुम्ही eligible आहात. Required percentage 75 आहे. Course साठी 6 seats remaining आहेत आणि annual fee 185000 आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask if there is any discount on the fee.
steps.text: Fee मध्ये काही discount मिळेल का?

steps.purpose: Clarify that the fee is fixed.
steps.text: Sorry, fee 185000 fixed आहे, system मध्ये discount ची कोणतीही माहिती नाही.

steps.purpose: Request to submit the application.
steps.text: Great. तर मग माझं application submit करा.

steps.purpose: Submit the application for the B.Tech course.
Return the submission status, reference number, and decision days.
Confirm submission with the reference number and explicitly state that submission is not admission.
steps.text: तुमचं application submit झालं आहे. Reference number REF-9921 आहे आणि decision 3 days मध्ये येईल. हे लक्षात ठेवा की application submit करणे म्हणजे admission confirm होणे नाही.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the submission.
Remind that documents are needed for review and ask if anything else is needed.
steps.text: लक्षात ठेवा, documents upload केल्यावरच admission committee review करेल. अजून काही माहिती हवी आहे का?

steps.purpose: End the call as the goal is resolved.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant encounters a valid tool failure when checking eligibility for 'Engineering' (e15), explains the issue to the user without inventing a cause (e16), and successfully recovers by checking a valid course 'B.Tech' (e17).

variant_findings.reason: The assistant violates the grounding constraint by stating the application status ('documents pending') in e7 before calling the lookup_applicant tool in e10 to retrieve this information.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e7, the assistant hallucinates the application status ('documents pending') before looking up the applicant's record. This not only violates the Tool Output Grounding variant but also creates a logical contradiction: the user immediately asks for the exact status (e8), the assistant looks it up and reports it again (e12), and the user inexplicably replies 'I already know that' (e13).
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e7. The assistant should acknowledge verification and state they are calling about application APP-1009 without revealing its status. The user should then ask why the application is stalled or what the status is. The assistant then calls `lookup_applicant`, finds it is 'documents_pending', and informs the user. The user can then reply that they will upload documents later but want to check if their marks are sufficient for Engineering, naturally leading into the failure recovery sequence.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates workflow recovery after a tool failure. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant and introduces a severe logical contradiction because the assistant states the application status before looking it up, leading to a redundant and confusing exchange. A suffix repair from the point of identity verification is required to fix the logical flow.
